jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. In addition, you will evaluate S/4 HANA Public Cloud innovations and support continuous improvement.Integration – You will ensure the provision and maintenance of SAP S/4 HANA-based processes and solutions within the EM area, as well as their end-to-end integration. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.Tasks & responsibilities- As a subject matter expert, you'll strategically protect Boehringer's people and assets, developing and implementing security policies and standards to strengthen future resilience.- Drawing on your expertise, you'll drive projects, fostering an agile security culture and delivering true business value as a business enabler.- As a subject matter expert, you'll coordinate and support Boehringer globally, monitoring compliance, supporting local workflows, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to uphold a strong security culture & awareness.- As a service delivery lead, you will ensure with the vendors, performance and efficiency by measuring through structured KPIs and other service monitoring.- You'll identify optimization opportunities to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of security services, strategies, and processes, and exceptional negotiation abilities define you- Experience in instructing and coaching internal and external colleagues- You're fluent in English and basic German, with any additional languages as a You'll define requirements for people protection with focus on employee security, security policies and standards that protect our people and assets, while fostering a culture of innovation and agility in security. jobs.description: About GFGlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.Your Job- You will be the responsible Program Manager for Technology Development Programs within GlobalFoundries' state-of-the-art 300 mm wafer fab (Fab1) in Dresden, Germany.- Plan and manage the execution for complex semiconductor engineering development programs.- Own the overall program schedule, resource allocation and alignment of program Milestone deliverables.- Ensure seamless transition from development phase into production.- Lead a cross-functional team of experts throughout the entire Technology Development Program defining tasks & work packages for in-time & in-quality program completion.- Work closely with Product Management, PMO, PDK, Modeling and IP Teams.- Communicate effectively internally as well as with customers within technical and executive forums. Required Qualifications- Masters/ Diploma degree in Engineering or Science (e.g. Physics, Chemistry, Materials) and/ or PhD.- Solid working knowledge of modern CMOS process integration.- Being a teamplayer with good oral and written communication skills in English are required.- Strong analytical, problem solving and project management skills.- You must have several years of experience in technical leadership roles within the semiconductor industry.- Track record in Technology Development and/or program management of complex, cross-functional engineering programs.- Experience in “More than Moore” development efforts like Embedded Memory, High-Voltage or RF/mmWave are a plus.- Fluent in English Language – written & verbal, Proficiency in German language is a plus.- Exposure to semiconductor volume manufacturing methods, statistical methods, FMEA/8D Methodology, external customer & multicultural working environment is beneficial.- Project Management Certification (eg. IPMA, PMP) is a plus.We Offer  The position is open-ended and to be filled as soon as possible.  Attractive compensation components:   13th month salary, bonus payments, assistance with relocation to Dresden.  Flexible working time arrangements:   Family friendly part-time models, trust flextime, salary conversion into free time  Diverse opportunities for further development:   Career stages for every job, internal qualification offers, promotion of external educational qualifications  Focus on your health:   On-site gym and beach volleyball court, bike leasing, subsidized employee restaurant  Corporate culture:   Cooperation at eye level - everyone is on first name terms with us, budget for individual team events, social commitment via GlobalGives  You can find more benefits in detail at  hier  Diversity is part of our corporate DNA. For this reason, we would like to encourage women in particular to apply for a job with us. As we value equal opportunities and inclusion is particularly important to us, we welcome applications from people with disabilities.The job advertisement refers to a position up to job level 8 on the Engineering career ladder.Information about our benefits you can find here: hierSchlagworte: CHIP,Englisch, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309601/experienced-program-manager-22fdx (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309601/experienced-program-manager-22fdx#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenÜber GFGlobalFoundries (GF) ist ein führender Hersteller von Halbleitern, auf die sich die Welt zum Leben, Arbeiten und Vernetzen verlässt. Wir sind innovativ und arbeiten mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um energieeffizientere und leistungsfähigere Produkte für die Automobilindustrie, intelligente mobile Geräte, das Internet der Dinge (IoT), Kommunikationsinfrastrukturen und andere wachstumsstarke Märkte zu entwickeln.Mit unserem globalen Produktionsnetzwerk, das sich über die USA, Europa und Asien erstreckt, sind wir eine vertrauenswürdige und zuverlässige Quelle für Kunden in aller Welt. Jeden Tag liefert unser talentiertes und vielfältiges Team Ergebnisse mit einem unnachgiebigen Fokus auf Sicherheit, Langlebigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. GF beschäftigt weltweit rund 13.000 Mitarbeitende, davon 3.000 in Dresden. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.gf.com.
